projects.title: Personal Portfolio Redesign
projects.overview: A premium, single-page, mobile-first brand website to showcase capabilities and drive enquiries.
projects.problem: Previous designs carried redundant dependencies, custom cursor scripts, and layout alignment errors on mobile.
projects.solution: Redesigned with custom CSS grids, fluid clamp variables, and lightweight Intersection Observers for layout entry states.
projects.results: Target Lighthouse scores of 100 in Performance, Accessibility, and SEO, with rapid load metrics.

projects.title: SEO Growth Campaign
projects.overview: Full-funnel technical search audit and keyword optimization for an e-commerce platform in India.
projects.problem: Low organic page indexation, duplicate titles, lack of schema markup, and stagnant search rankings.
projects.solution: Re-coded robots.txt, established site sitemaps, integrated detailed JSON-LD graphs, and fixed keyword gaps.
projects.results: Significant organic visibility gain, rich snippet results in SERP, and lower bounce rates in 60 days.

projects.title: Restaurant Branding Web Layout
projects.overview: Responsive frontend showcase designed to present custom menus and streamline table queries.
projects.problem: Hard-coded layouts, lack of touch-friendly buttons on mobile, and slow rendering of image cards.
projects.solution: Rebuilt using fluid CSS Grid alignments, optimized layout rendering times, and clean CTA button targets.
projects.results: Smooth multi-viewport displays and a clean layout codebase ready for backend integrations.

projects.title: Social Media B2B Conversion Funnel
projects.overview: Meta Ads conversion campaign setup optimized for acquiring targeted B2B corporate inquiries.
projects.problem: Poor audience profiling leading to spam form submissions and high cost-per-lead (CPL) ratios.
projects.solution: Custom audience lookalikes setup, pixel custom events tracking, and high-impact copy tests.
projects.results: Reduced average CPL metrics, while generating pre-qualified business leads.
